from shopkit.money import format_money
from shopkit.orders.models import Order
from shopkit.utils.text import normalize_sku


def render_invoice_text(order: Order) -> str:
    """Plain-text invoice sent to customers by email."""
    rows = [f"Invoice {order.id}"]
    for line in order.lines:
        rows.append(f"{normalize_sku(line.sku):<16}{line.qty:>4} x {format_money(line.unit_cents, order.currency):>12}"
                    f"  = {format_money(line.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")
    rows.append(f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(order.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")
    return "\n".join(rows)

"""Invoice header and footer blocks shared by the text and HTML invoice renderers."""
from datetime import date

from shopkit.config import SETTINGS
from shopkit.customers.addresses import format_address
from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.utils.dates import add_business_days

PAYMENT_TERMS_DAYS = 14
COMPANY = ["Shopkit Ltd", "1 Market Street", "Springfield, IL 62701", "US"]


def header(invoice_number: str, issued: date, bill_to: Address) -> str:
    due = add_business_days(issued, PAYMENT_TERMS_DAYS)
    parts = ["\n".join(COMPANY), "", f"Invoice number: {invoice_number}",
             f"Issued: {issued.isoformat()}   Due: {due.isoformat()}", "", "Bill to:",
             format_address(bill_to)]
    return "\n".join(parts)


def footer() -> str:
    return f"Questions? Contact {SETTINGS.support_email}. Thank you for your order."

"""Issue invoices for paid orders and credit notes for refunds, keeping both sequences gap-free."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.invoices import credit_notes
from shopkit.invoices.layout import footer, header
from shopkit.invoices.numbering import next_invoice_number
from shopkit.invoices.render import render_invoice_text
from shopkit.orders.models import Order


@dataclass
class IssuedInvoice:
    number: str
    order_id: str
    issued: date
    text: str


@dataclass
class InvoiceRegister:
    invoices: list[IssuedInvoice] = field(default_factory=list)
    credit_notes: list[credit_notes.CreditNote] = field(default_factory=list)

    def last_number(self) -> str | None:
        return self.invoices[-1].number if self.invoices else None

    def issue(self, order: Order, bill_to: Address, issued: date) -> IssuedInvoice:
        if any(i.order_id == order.id for i in self.invoices):
            raise ValueError(f"order {order.id} is already invoiced")
        number = next_invoice_number(self.last_number(), issued.year)
        text = "\n\n".join([header(number, issued, bill_to), render_invoice_text(order), footer()])
        invoice = IssuedInvoice(number, order.id, issued, text)
        self.invoices.append(invoice)
        return invoice

    def credit(self, order_id: str, refund_cents: int, currency: str, issued: date,
               reason: str) -> credit_notes.CreditNote:
        invoice = next(i for i in self.invoices if i.order_id == order_id)
        last = self.credit_notes[-1].number if self.credit_notes else None
        note = credit_notes.issue(last, invoice.number, refund_cents, currency, issued, reason)
        self.credit_notes.append(note)
        return note

"""Checkout: turns a cart into a priced order with tax, shipping and discounts, then takes payment."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from shopkit.catalog.models import Product
from shopkit.catalog.pricing import PriceBook
from shopkit.customers.models import Address
from shopkit.errors import ShopError
from shopkit.orders.models import Order, OrderLine
from shopkit.promotions.coupons import Coupon, discount_cents
from shopkit.shipping.rates import shipping_cents
from shopkit.tax.calculator import order_tax
from shopkit.utils.ids import new_id


class EmptyCart(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


class NotPurchasable(ShopError):
    http_status = 422


@dataclass
class Quote:
    order: Order
    subtotal_cents: int
    discount_cents: int
    shipping_cents: int
    tax_cents: int
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def total_cents(self) -> int:
        return self.subtotal_cents - self.discount_cents + self.shipping_cents + self.tax_cents


def quote(cart: dict[str, int], products: dict[str, Product], ship_to: Address, weight_g: int,
          prices: PriceBook, today: date, coupon: Coupon | None = None) -> Quote:
    """Price a cart (sku -> qty). Tax applies after discount on the goods; shipping is untaxed."""
    if not cart:
        raise EmptyCart("cart is empty")
    order = Order(id=new_id("ord"))
    for sku, qty in cart.items():
        product = products[sku]
        if not product.is_purchasable():
            raise NotPurchasable(f"{sku} is not available", sku=sku)
        order.lines.append(OrderLine(sku, qty, prices.unit_price(product, qty, today)))
    subtotal = order.total_cents
    discount = discount_cents(coupon, subtotal, today) if coupon else 0
    tax = order_tax(order, ship_to)
    if discount and subtotal:
        tax = tax * (subtotal - discount) // subtotal
    return Quote(order, subtotal, discount, shipping_cents(ship_to.country, weight_g, subtotal), tax)

"""Picking and packing. Builds pick lists for the warehouse and splits orders into parcels."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from shopkit.orders.models import Order
from shopkit.shipping.packaging import format_weight
from shopkit.utils.collections import chunked, group_by

MAX_ITEMS_PER_PARCEL = 10


@dataclass
class Parcel:
    order_id: str
    number: int
    items: list[tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=list)    # (sku, qty)
    gift_message: str = ""

    @property
    def item_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(q for _, q in self.items)


def pick_list(orders: list[Order]) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Total quantity per SKU across orders, sorted by SKU (the order pickers walk the aisles)."""
    by_sku = group_by((line for o in orders for line in o.lines), key=lambda l: l.sku)
    return sorted((sku, sum(l.qty for l in lines)) for sku, lines in by_sku.items())


def split_into_parcels(order: Order, max_items: int = MAX_ITEMS_PER_PARCEL) -> list[Parcel]:
    """One unit per slot, at most `max_items` units per parcel, lines kept together where possible.

    The order's gift message is carried on the first parcel only, so it is printed on one
    packing slip."""
    units = [line.sku for line in order.lines for _ in range(line.qty)]
    parcels = []
    for n, batch in enumerate(chunked(units, max_items), start=1):
        counts = group_by(batch, key=lambda s: s)
        parcels.append(Parcel(order.id, n, [(sku, len(v)) for sku, v in counts.items()],
                              gift_message=order.gift_message if n == 1 else ""))
    return parcels


def packing_slip(parcel: Parcel, weight_g: int) -> str:
    """Slip packed inside each parcel: order, parcel number, contents and weight, plus the gift
    message when the parcel carries one (first parcel only)."""
    lines = [f"Order {parcel.order_id} - parcel {parcel.number}", f"Weight: {format_weight(weight_g)}"]
    lines += [f"  {qty} x {sku}" for sku, qty in parcel.items]
    if parcel.gift_message:
        lines.append(f"Gift message: {parcel.gift_message}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

from shopkit.catalog.models import Product
from shopkit.customers.models import Customer
from shopkit.money import format_money
from shopkit.orders.models import Order


def money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> dict:
    return {"cents": cents, "display": format_money(cents, currency), "currency": currency}


def product(p: Product) -> dict:
    return {"sku": p.sku, "title": p.title, "price": money(p.price_cents), "active": p.active,
            "purchasable": p.is_purchasable()}


def order(o: Order, status: str | None = None) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": o.id,
        "status": status,
        "lines": [{"sku": l.sku, "qty": l.qty, "unit": money(l.unit_cents, o.currency),
                   "total": money(l.total_cents, o.currency)} for l in o.lines],
        "total": money(o.total_cents, o.currency),
        "gift_message": o.gift_message,
    }


def customer(c: Customer) -> dict:
    return {"id": c.id, "email": c.email, "name": c.name, "tier": c.tier,
            "marketing_opt_in": c.marketing_opt_in}

def money(cents: int, currency: str = "USD") -> dict:
    return {"cents": cents, "display": format_money(cents, currency), "currency": currency}


def product(p: Product) -> dict:
    return {"sku": p.sku, "title": p.title, "price": money(p.price_cents), "active": p.active,
            "purchasable": p.is_purchasable()}


def order(o: Order, status: str | None = None) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": o.id,
        "status": status,
        "lines": [{"sku": l.sku, "qty": l.qty, "unit": money(l.unit_cents, o.currency),
                   "total": money(l.total_cents, o.currency)} for l in o.lines],
        "total": money(o.total_cents, o.currency),
        "gift_message": o.gift_message,
    }


def customer(c: Customer) -> dict:
    return {"id": c.id, "email": c.email, "name": c.name, "tier": c.tier,
            "marketing_opt_in": c.marketing_opt_in}
